title: Admin: asset detail with handover actions
interface: Extends base.html. Shows all asset fields and the status span; the current holder (variable holder: employee dict or None); a section 'Předat zaměstnanci' with form POST /admin/assets/<id>/handover (select employee_email from `employees` — show display_name and e-mail as the option text, value=email — and input note) shown only when asset.status == 'in_stock'; a form POST /admin/assets/<id>/return shown when status == 'assigned'; forms POST .../retire and .../lost shown when status in ('in_stock','retired','lost'); a link to /admin/assets/<id>/edit; a table of handovers (variable handovers with keys protocol_number, kind, status, created_at, confirmed_at, employee.display_name, and a cancel form POST /admin/handovers/<id>/cancel when status == 'pending'; a link to /api/v1/handovers/<id>/protocol.pdf when protocol_path); a table of the assignment history (variable history with employee names). Variables: asset, holder, employees, handovers, history. Czech.

uses.base: templates/base.html: Jinja layout with blocks title and content; header nav (Moje zařízení '/', for admins: /admin/assets, /admin/handovers, /admin/employees, /admin/audit), current user e-mail and a logout form POST /auth/logout; flashed messages via get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true); links /static/style.css
